**Verdict: FAIL** on candidate `sha256:5dfecce4…92b8` (552 files, source 8488e7a). The round-11 fix verifies, but the BE17 upload rework introduced one regression, and the assignment's rule is that anything regressed means FAIL.

I confirmed the candidate ID at the start and the end of the run. All test runs were in throwaway copies, removed afterwards. I did not read any other reviewer's round-12 records.

## F-DG2-430 (Low): CLOSED_VERIFIED
- **Unit logs clean:** `pnpm test` ran 7 times (Node 22 ×3, Node 24 ×3, both locale settings, plus one run under CPU load). Every run passed 790/790, with no `Cannot update a component` line and no act() warning.
- **Team preview works:** in English (left-to-right) and Arabic (right-to-left), the role preview follows the role picker through all 5 roles and back, and the text matches the server's. After Cancel, nothing is assigned.
- **The new guard works:** when I put the old bug back, the guard fails the tests in both locale settings. With the guard switched off, the same bug passes and only prints the warning, so the guard is what catches it.
- **No other cases:** a sweep of all 13 state updaters in the web app found none with side effects.

## New finding: F-DG2-460 (Medium, not mandatory, owner backend-workflow-engineer)
If the server is shut down (SIGTERM) while an evidence upload is still arriving, a leftover temporary `.part` file stays in the evidence store.
- It holds the user's partial upload (2 MiB in my test).
- It survives a restart, and nothing ever deletes it.
- No database record points to it and it can't be downloaded, so records stay intact.
- Each restart or deploy that interrupts an upload leaks up to 25 MiB of user evidence that nothing tracks.

**It's a regression:** the same test on the round-11 candidate (309aff2) leaves nothing. My round-11 shutdown test (R11-02) passed 4 of 4 then and fails 4 of 4 now; a dedicated test (R12-07) reproduces it in both locale settings. If the user aborts instead, with the server still running, the file is cleaned up correctly.

**Probable cause:** the upload body is now received without holding a database connection. Shutdown used to wait for that connection to be released, and with it for the file cleanup. Now it exits before the cleanup finishes.

## Everything else passed
- **Upload checks requested for BE17:**
  - An item edited during an upload gives 409 with nothing stored, and the edit itself isn't blocked.
  - Two uploads racing on the same version produce exactly one winner.
  - 25 stalled uploads (more than the 20 database connections) don't slow other users or `/readyz`. No database session sits idle in a transaction, and a positive control shows the check would catch one.
  - Aborted request bodies give no 500 and no error-level log line.
  - Binary uploads are stored byte-exact.
  - Arabic and emoji text comes back unchanged.
  - The R8-05/R9-05 form errors still show each message once.
- **Static checks:** typecheck, build, lint, OpenAPI lint (161 operations), no-CDN, formatting, contrast.
- **Integration:** 6 runs (3 per locale setting), 640/640 tests each, migrations 0001–0019 applied.
- **Product e2e:** 64/64 per locale setting, including Define→G2 and Design→G3.
- **My acceptance stack:** 128 passed per locale setting; the only 2 failures are the R11-02 test above. The log shows the database is UTF-8.
- **Accessibility:** 636 axe scans, none serious or critical.
- **Validators:** historical DG1, register, pipeline and reconcile all pass.

**Not checked live:** the live registry (D-057), live CI (D-058) and Keycloak (D-049). Each passes on the offline/config side, as the assignment specifies; the live checks remain open. The dependency-pin check times out without network access, which is expected.

Every non-zero exit and warning line in the cited logs is explained in the record.

No business approval is implied.

Files are in `docs/delivery/reviews/DG2/round-12/`:
- `qa-verifier.json`
- `qa-verifier.verifications.json`
- `qa-verifier.findings.json`
- `qa-verifier.md`

Evidence is under `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG2/qa/round-12/` and the new test file is `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG2/qa/tests/round-12/e2e/dg2-qa-r12.spec.ts`.
